subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable `systemPromptReport` storage policy should OpenClaw use for retained session entries without regressing warning dedupe or context diagnostics?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but choosing between minimal summaries, active-only retention, and out-of-line full reports changes persisted session metadata semantics and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Persist Minimal Durable Summary
options.body: Keep only the small fields needed across restarts, such as warning-dedupe state, and omit or externalize large `tools`, `skills`, and injected-file arrays from retained rows.

options.title: Store Full Reports Out Of Line
options.body: Move full prompt reports to content-addressed or session-scoped artifacts while keeping `sessions.json` as a lightweight index with explicit cleanup ownership.

options.title: Keep Full Reports Only For Active Sessions
options.body: Strip full reports from stale or inactive entries during write-time or maintenance compaction while preserving them for the current session context.

recommendation.title: Persist Minimal Durable Summary
recommendation.body: Keep only the small fields needed across restarts, such as warning-dedupe state, and omit or externalize large `tools`, `skills`, and injected-file arrays from retained rows.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the original prompt-report feature and the adjacent session metadata policy, making them the strongest owner for the durable-storage choice.
